predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Watford vs Blackburn: Expected Goals (xG), Coaching Turmoil & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Blackburn's superior forward threat (1.50 goals per game) and away draw resilience support a Draw / Away Win call centered on 1:1 and 1:2, with Both Teams To Score (Yes) and Under 2.5 total goals.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Draw / Away Win — Blackburn avoid defeat at Vicarage Road via compact away transitions or an Andri Gudjohnsen-led clinical counter (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Secondary Angle: Under 2.5 Goals with BTTS Yes — Watford's home caution and 67.9% big-chance waste keep totals bounded to 2 or 3 goals while both 1.77 xGA defenses concede (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Contingency Angle: Watford 1:0 Home Shutout — An interim defensive bounce capitalizing on Blackburn's missing keeper Balazs Toth and Sam Morsy's midfield doubt (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Interim coaches clash as Blackburn's attack tests Watford's home steel.

spf.comment: Anchored on the 1:1 modal draw and 1:2 away win, retaining both outcomes because Watford's home resilience balances Blackburn's finishing edge while a single-outcome call would ignore Rovers' 50% away draw rate.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 52.3% Poisson Under 2.5 rating, Watford's 56.2% season Under 2.5 frequency, and 2.58 combined lambda expectancy.

btts.comment: Both clubs allow 1.77 xGA per game and face defensive or goalkeeping absences, aligning with a 53.1% model probability and Blackburn's 75.0% season BTTS rate.

score.comment: 1:1 leads the Dixon-Coles matrix at 13.2% given Blackburn's four away draws, while 1:2 captures Rovers' superior 56.9 FW-OTI breaking an unsettled host late.

goals.comment: Two goals (25.8%) and three goals (21.7%) represent the two densest buckets in the total-goals distribution, matching the 1:1 and 1:2 projections.

bqc.comment: Both clubs show 50% half-time draw rates in tonight's venue splits, setting up an even first half before either staying deadlocked or tilting late to Blackburn.
